reviews.text: Ace veterinarian clinic really helped out my cat Suri. They were quick, and fast.  They had all the medications that my cat needed and they also had the special hills diet for her incontinence. Their follow-up on text was very beneficial, and in a timely manner. I highly recommend Ace veterinarian clinic for your pet care.

Let me share a quick piece of advice to safeguard your hard-earned money and prevent you from wasting it away in literally one minute. The culprit? A hidden $23 "Wellness/Consultation" charge.
I brought my pet in for a routine visit, and just one week later, I returned for a follow-up vaccination that was supposed to cost $21.95. To make a long story short, my total bill came out to $44.95. Why? Because they tacked on another redundant $23 Wellness/Consultation fee for a visit that lasted under sixty seconds. The vet simply asked, "Is he okay? Any concerns?", gave my pet a few quick pats on the body, and just like that, I was charged.
When I questioned the fee and asked why it wasn't disclosed upfront, I was given a typical, after-the-fact explanation. While the staff is professional and does their job well, please be aware of these non-disclosed, repetitive fees for follow-up appointments. Check your bill carefully! Be vigilant about undisclosed fees during follow-up visits.
Excellent service and very fair and affordable prices. Thank you so much for your excellence.
I was referred to this clinic by SA Feral Cat Coalition to treat a sick kitten from a cat colony. They were responsive, attentive, and affordable. They are truly an "ACE" Vet clinic.
I always visit this clinic and my cats don't go back for the same reason: they are very good and friendly.
They are fantastic and so kind and even let us come in the weekend! We are so thankful we found them! Thank you!!!!!!
I've been using Ace vet for many years, highly recommend. You can even text them to schedule appointments! Very affordable as well.

I was able to schedule an appointment and get my dog seen and under a day from this clinic, he was having a medical emergency and they were very accommodating and kind, their prices are fair, and I didn’t feel like I was being taken advantage of like I have other clinics. The techs are extremely knowledgeable and kind with the animals. You can tell everybody here really loves what they do and are good at it.

I thoroughly satisfied with the excellent treatment by the Dr and staff of ACE vet. I was a wreck worried for my girls swollen inflamed eye. The prices are very reasonable. First exam cost $23. After that it's 38$. Which compared to other places
1# I couldn't get a live person to talk to.
2# The prices just to be seen were crazy high. Eg. Petco said it was free first exam, no it isn't, it would be $85 to be seen.
I got her exam, eye cornea test and 2 meds for less than $124. My peace of mind is priceless. All thanks to God. Also God is so good, a lady volunteered to pay for my dogs nail trim. That made me so happy. Yes everyone take your pets to ACE.
I like this place I have more the 5  cats razonable prices dr he do very good job he knows  how to help my cats  on

Was actually recommended this place from another vet as a more affordable alternative! Prices were miles better than other places now days and everyone was very nice and helpful. Will definitely be back next time my cats need anything! Only $23 for a regular exam, $38 for a sick exam which is still about half off the other options I've used!

They are rare in the vet care industry. They have empathy and affordable prices. Saved my Lilys life (10 yr Siamese). Dr Lan, Emily, Abby and Marisa all gave 100%. Whole staff smiling and caring. You can trust your fur babies with them.

I just wanted to post my review on Ace Vet at barchester rd. I absolutely love this vet. From the moment I walk in, the staff is very welcoming. They always accomodate the fact that my dog does not like other dogs, so they put him in a room right away. They are very kind, never rude, and very affordable. Dr. Lan is a very good vet, I wish more vets were as nice as he is. I have never felt like they are trying to tag more things on my 💸 bill. I trust Dr. Lan and his staff with my pets anyday.

I want to update my review based on my most recent experience. Excellent diagnosis to allow the best end of life care for my Kitty and intervention to promote pre- surgical care for my kitten who is scheduled for a tail Amputation with a Veternary surgeon.
Wonderful place to take your pets.  Both my kitties are back to feeling better. The cost wasnt bad.  I spent more on medications then their exam.

Never answers the phone. I have called them multiple times and they won’t answer but send me a text asking if I needed anything and then when I say I need a phone call back they just simply ignore my messages and my calls. Update since I can’t respond to your response you didn’t reply to my text until 3:33 pm when your office closes at 1:00 p.m. and right before your response to my message. I also called one minute after my text from your office and I couldn’t get a response. This is the third time this has happened to me. I have since already been able to reach another vet that is available.
Excellent staff Excellent care for the animals thank you
They do a great job with my cats.  The price is reasonable. They figured out my cat's allergies.

I am 40 years old, and I've had my dog bailey for almost the last decade. Prior to her, I've never been without a pet, almost always a dog. In all these years I can't say I've had a more straight forward and affordable experience in my life. Friday evening, I was terrified to see that when I let her out she peed blood. I didn't know what to do and I searched for hours in vain trying to find a vet that I could afford. I had terrible luck calling around after 5pm on a Friday of course, so I decided I'd monitor and start again first thing in the morning (as she had no other symptoms and was acting normally otherwise). I called several clinics Saturday morning and was of course declined all over as they either had limited hours or were not taking new patients. Ace didn't answer at first, but they called me back after a few minutes and let me tell you it was smooth sailing from there. I was in the office within 3 hours. While Dr. Lan may seem all business, I DON'T MIND, I'm not there for a new best friend, I want my dog treated. He listened, did the necessary tests, and prescribed us the medication he thought we needed while assuring us that he'd send off the urinalysis and text the results next day. The man was true to his word. The nurses were all awesome, no notes there, and the labs reported that his initial diagnosis was correct and all I had to do was continue the treatment plan she was on. 4 days later here I am with a dog who's finally peeing clear and very clearly feeling better. What a great experience. And y'all...the exam fee was $23 dollars!!! Highly recommend!

Dr. Lan is amazing, compassionate and kind to the animals and his vet tech Nicole was so patient and caring with my shy Frenchie.
They are very transparent about pricing and ask you if you're okay with something before they do it. Unlike other vet offices.

They give you an estimate and make sure that you are okay with all the prices and communicate everything very clearly. I absolutely recommend and very affordable prices.

Our Chihuahua mix, Dobby, had quickly developed a wide-spread bacterial skin infection due to allergies (we are new to San Antonio). Ace was able to work us in immediately the same morning I called without the prices of an urgent care/emergency vet. I also love that I can easily communicate with them through text. The vet techs and staff that we encountered were all so kind, knowledgeable, and helpful. You can tell they all have a heart for animals. The Doctor thoroughly checked our dog and prescribed a regimen that started keeping Dobby more comfortable that same day! Here we are about two days later, and he's looking, feeling, and smelling so much better. Ace's prices are very reasonable. I actually shopped around out of curiosity for the meds Dobby was prescribed, and Ace's prices were the best. We will definitely be taking our pets here from now on!
My friend received the attention needed. Staff showed respect & Doctor wise. 💯
Friendly staff,
Outstanding veterinary care and value. Thank you!
I took my 2 feral cats in today. I think Dr Lam is the only vet that will see ferals. He is knowledgeable and very kind.
Excellent care for my dogs. I've been coming here for years and everyone is great.
Very strategic and focused vet! Opened on weekends which has been a literal  life saver
I would like to thank you all for taking excellent care of my fur baby. The whole team is the best!

The dr doesn't say much but his knowledge is clear. He fixed my poor doggy. Staff is friendly and professional. The service is great and very affordable. Definitely will bring my fur baby back to dr Lan.
staff was awesome took in my 3 dogs this morning for rabies shots and they did a ultrasound on my expecting mama dog. Definitely my go to vet

Love. This place may be small, but it’s truly one of the best. I highly recommend it to anyone.
The tender, loving care they give to your fur babies is unmatched—100% and more.
Their service is exceptional, and their staff and doctor are amazing at what they do.
Thank you again to everyone at Ace Veterinary Clinic for the incredible care and dedication you show every day.
Freindly staff, knowledgeable doctor, & great prices.
Overall a fine and caring staff.
We’re new to this clinic, but so far it’s been great!

The nurses and doctor were very helpful and fast. Unfortunately my cat baby came out positive for Leukemia but the staff was quickly to let us check our other babies that same day since its viral. Thank y'all for the hard work y'all do

Amazingly fast service (I can typically arrive and leave in under half hour), very professional staff and very reasonable prices. Most importantly their main goal is to take care of your pet, not upsell (ah em VCA...).
Dr. Han has taken great care of my dogs for the last 10 years.  Staff is great.

I’ve had a great experience with this vet clinic! The staff is always responsive and friendly, and I really appreciate how quickly they get back with test results and updates. They provide excellent care without overcharging, which is hard to find these days. It’s clear they genuinely care about the animals they treat, and that gives me peace of mind every time I bring my dog in. Quality service, fair pricing, and compassionate care — I couldn’t ask for more.

I took my dog to see this vet after a referral from the SAHS.I have 4 dogs to provide for so the low cost aspect drew me there. My dog has a gi problem and after some testing-and a very simple heartworm test-the vet decided she was heartworm positive.I saw the cartridge of the test and could not see the positive line-the tech said it is very faint-I have no vision issue and it was not there at all. He prescribed her heartworm therapy with no instructions at all. I was very  confused as she came from the shelter negative as are all of my other dogs-they all get their wormer on time every month. i was provided a bill of $700 and a bag of meds which i had no idea what was what.I was in shock at the whole episode and didnt know what to do at that pointI am not afraid to speak up and I tried but no help at all.. I have had pets all of my life and take very good care of them.I have to say that I left in shock at the diagnosis, communication and the bill. Heartworm therapy is a serious matter and a dog can get sicker or die is mishandled or treated inappropriatly. I had to take her to another vet and start all over.Needless to say, they double tested and no heartworms. Her gi problem is not an unusual one and small consertative steps must be taken to remedy the condition.
I am sure this vet is fine for routine care and his techs are very kind but I will never refer anyone here and i am also letting the SAHS know what happened. I am so relieved that I did not follow his treatment plan as I could have made her very sick or lost her completely.

A lot of the vet’s around town are merging with Thrive and I am not a fan. The system is inefficient and taking away from the quality of care. I was forced to make an appt with a new vet today due to these reasons with my old vet.

I saw good reviews on Ace Vet so I called to make an appt and they took me right away! The Doctor and the staff are incredible. They are caring and the doctor is straight to the point. He tells you what your pet needs and what he recommends but doesn’t push you on unnecessary treatments. They were very affordable and the care was impeccable. I am very very very happy! It feels like the old days and having a small town vet vibe. I will definitely be back!

Bonus - they text you for communication! Love that!

A dog showed up in our yard mid week and was limping. Thanks to a couple of positive Facebook recommendations, we ended up choosing this clinic to take him too. I was able to get an appointment same day via text. The staff was super helpful and explained things in a way that was easy to understand. They gave us a referral to an animal hospital and some pain meds for him. The process was easy and prices were reasonable. We were even able to get the meds there in a matter of minutes. Highly recommend!
No bells or whistles but good and great cost veterinary clinic.
They do not do walk-ins however their staff was able to accommodate me with a same day appointment and within an hour my puppy had his vaccines. He also really liked the staff
Fast and professional services ! Also very understanding and patient with my yappy girl !

10/10
The nurses and vet super nice!
They get to the point and very affordable. Definitely will be bring our fur babies back

I would personally like to thank the Dr.Lan and the staff at Ace Vet clinic.I want everyone to know that Dr.Lan is the best Vet in San Antonio and he is very reasonable priced. I also need to say thank you to his staff.I have used other vets, but I would suggest going here first.$$$$$$

The staff is super friendly. The receptionist is always super helpful. Even with my 5 billion questions. The techs are both so caring and you can see they are pet mommas. The doctor is extremely gentle and sweet. I cannot say enough good things.
Very compassionate staff and an amazing veterinarian!
Nothing fancy just the basics at affordable prices. Helpful and pleasant staff.
Today was my first time ever coming here. The staff is amazing. The vet is amazing. I have a new vet home care for the future needs of all my pets. ❤️
Dr Lin is a great doctor, very compassionate with our pets. Thank you Dr Lin

My dog had a broken nail he was in pain. The doctor and the girls were very nice 👍 my dog got treated and got antibiotics. The awesome thing was that I did not make an appointment it was just a walk-in and fast.Thank you for helping me in a short time!! My dog feels a lot better❤️🙏 …

We had a doctor that failed to express to us the gravity of the situation with our cat. They just gave us a supplement and a prescription food to something that wasnt even purchasable in the country. No complaints about the nurses here, but i cant recommend a place that has doctors like the one i had. Another doctor at a different business got the ball rolling in our cats care. Glad i got a second opinion.
Always a great experience!

Brought a stray cat in with a severe eye injury & got her exam, antibiotics, rabies & other shots & tested for diseases all for a reasonable price. Was given recommendations for a clinic to have her eye removed.
I’ve been here a year ago for another feral that needed medical attention and it went well.
Today I saw Nicole and Angela and they were professional. Dr. Lan was efficient and did a thorough exam. He can’t talk I’m guessing due to a medical condition, but he is still working and caring for animals at a reasonable price.
His techs voice his notes that he writes and I got my questions answered that way. I’m thankful for a Vet clinic I can afford to take my very sick feral cats to. Any other clinic would be out of my price range to care for my colony of feral/semi-feral cats that I TNR.
I hope that whatever Dr. Lan is going thru with his voice he will find healing. Thank you for all you do & Happy New Year.
Best place for pets

Update: 12/22/24 this is a wonderful Dr. & staff. Thank you for all that you do. Thank you for serving your community and offering reasonable & effective care. I had to bring my dog in for an ingrown toenail and they took care of her and got us what we needed. Straight to the point.

01/05/25 Had to bring my other dog today. Grateful for Dr. Hao C. Lan & staff at Ace Veterinary Clinic. The doctor has been experiencing a medical situation himself lately (reason the staff has to talk for him) and even then he is working to treat the community’s pets. May God bless and heal him from whatever he’s going through.
Super awsome and helped me with my dogs

I have been taking my 5 pets here for a couple of years.  Never had any issues until today.  Abigail,  who i never had the displeasure of meeting before was awful. She was rude, aggressive and condescending. I asked for a few minutes to decide on heartworm and she immediately became confrontational and guilt tripping. Bc of her, I do not plan to ever return to this clinic. The rest of the staff is and always has been great.

I have been going here for years and have never had issues. But in the past 6 months they shortened their hours by half and literally DO NOT answer my phone calls or texts. It’s driven me so crazy because it takes a week before I can actually get my dog scheduled for an appointment. I’ve decided to switch vets because of this hassle.
It's a good store with very good products and good customer service.

If you have a cat, do not bring them to this vet! Not only are the staff members incapable of treating cats with respect or gentle care, they act bothered by your very presence in the “clinic”. The vet (Dr. Hao C. Lan) has his assistant “Abby” tell you that “the doctor is unable to speak” and that “she is going to translate if he needs to talk”. When the vet walked in to the room to administer a rabies vaccination to my cat, he didn’t look up, he didn’t even try to smile or nod or even acknowledge my presence at all,  he walks into the room with a needle in his hand, forcefully jams a needle into my cats back leg extremely hard, then taps on the door to tell the assistant to move the trash can. It was beyond an inhuman and impersonal experience. This clinic may offer cheap vaccinations for your pet, but there is a complete lack of compassion in the vet staff. We must vote with our money and not continue to support a business who has no desire to make an effort with customers. Avoid, at all costs.
Very knowledgeable vet and honest to say find another vet {and soon}. Very reasonably priced in service and meds.

My dogs and cats were all new patients. My dogs' previous vet became out of my budget so I had to find another vet. Dr. Lan is the real deal. He's no-nonsense, very thorough & honest. He's a doctor not a salesman and explained to me the most effective, appropriate, timely & economical treatment for my animal companions. He had all my dogs' and cats' meds in stock. He's a great listener and answered all my Qs. I look forward to many years of having my dogs and cats treated by Dr. Lan. Nicole and Abby are very friendly, smart, thorough, and easy to communicate with. These two ladies are true assets to this vet clinic. Thank you, Dr. Lan!
The employees are also kind and so helpful.
Not at all helpful. Don't answer phone calls or text messages during business hours. The high ratings really surprised me.
Great place, always helpful when it comes to my dog.
Love this vet clinic! I take all of my animals here & new puppies if needed! Very good prices & friendly staff! Would for sure recommend this location!

I was so relieved after this visit. I rescued my dog and found out he has heart worms. I spent time researching a cost-effective treatment. I learned that a cap full of apple cider vinegar in his water provides a slow kill treatment.
It kills all the baby worms, and the adult worms take 5 to 7 years to die. I brought my dog in for treatment to treat the damage already done and start what I thought would be a monthly expense for the rest of his life, aside from the regular heart guard prevention.
To my surprise, the doctor was going to prescribe a slow kill treatment.  I explained about the apple cider vinegar, and he agreed that it was a good source of treatment.
He prescribed a steroid and antibiotic to be taken for 1 month. In total, I spent $130 to treat my rescue dog for heart worms. I was so relieved.  Ty

I took my puppy there. The vet came in with an assistant because for some reason he couldn't talk. He wrote things down and she would tell us what he said. Our puppy turned out to have parvo. The vet had his assistant tell us our puppies …
Very good service. Friendly and clean.
